completion_criteria: A buyer can discover, compare, buy, track delivery, cancel, return or replace, raise a grievance, and obtain support with persisted state and visible outcomes.
A seller can onboard, manage roles, import/publish catalog, fulfil to SLA, track delivery/itinerary and payment received, settle/refund, and inspect operational analytics.
One current-source Gate 8 receipt passes with no unresolved launch blocker and names the tested fingerprint and environment.
The authenticated portal shows the correct legal organisation and a current dated inventory of participant profiles; production scope approval remains owned by A2.
One approved role/domain matrix exists and is consistent with the product launch scope.
A4, B4-B8, and agreement/disclosure work can be scoped from that matrix without assumptions.
Production registry readback shows the approved subscriber roles/domains and keys.
Public DNS, TLS, site verification, and on_subscribe pass against the exact deployed source.
The approved production policy is enforced and security acceptance proves each listed control on the release source.
A dated restore succeeds from encrypted backup within approved recovery objectives.
Capacity and failover evidence covers the launch envelope.
The provider is contractually approved and production-certified.
Receipts, signed webhooks, idempotency, refunds, reconciliation, settlement, payouts, and failure/unknown-outcome recovery pass end to end.
All required agreements, contacts, terms, and customer disclosures are approved, published, and consistent with the launched roles and money flows.
One external LSP journey completes signed confirm, update, status, track, cancellation, and exception callbacks with correlation, Buyer/Seller delivery tracking, and terminal state.

The approved official conformance lane completes signed ONDC select, init, confirm, fulfilment, status, track, cancellation, return, refund, and settlement callbacks with correlated, persisted evidence.
A customer grievance or support issue can be traced from creation through resolution with signed network callbacks, audit history, escalation owner, response target, and Buyer/Seller-visible outcome.
Order, payment, refund, settlement, fee, and payout records reconcile without unexplained variance, and exception ownership is tested.
The official report is retained and every reported defect is closed or explicitly accepted before go-live.
The portal and network owners show the approved production roles/domains as go-live eligible, with all mandatory conformance evidence retained.
Every autonomous write is covered by the canonical risk policy, exact approval or mandate, durable receipt, revocation, and audit trail.
The exact deployed source passes the required public Buyer/Seller release journeys with no unresolved launch blocker.
Approved SLOs and dashboards cover critical paths, and a retained alert drill proves routing and diagnosis.
A dated restore meets approved recovery objectives and record-integrity checks.
End-to-end production-like reconciliation closes without unexplained variance and every exception has a tested recovery path.
Named responders complete retained exercises within approved response and recovery targets.
An independent report covers the release architecture and no unaccepted launch-critical finding remains.
The approved inventory maps every production data class to enforced retention, deletion, access, and model-use rules.
Support can diagnose and recover the approved scenarios within response targets using least-privilege tooling and retained audit evidence.
A retained rehearsal proves phased enablement, automatic/manual stop conditions, global write containment, rollback, and safe restoration.
Release accessibility passes and retained load/resilience/DR results meet approved thresholds with no unresolved launch blocker.
